fee_notes: Royalty 6% of Net Sales for most bakeries; Auntie Anne's Co-Branded in Other Locations: 6% Cinnabon + 7-8% Auntie Anne's; Express in Schlotzsky's: per-case product price. Ad contribution: 2.5% for Other Locations (except Auntie Anne's Co-Branded); 3% for Streetside and Swirl; not charged for Express in Schlotzsky's. Local Marketing Obligation: 1% of Net Sales per quarter. Total Advertising Contribution + Local Marketing Obligation capped at 5% of Net Sales.
raw_excerpt: Royalty Fee 6% of Net Sales...Advertising Contribution Bakeries in Other Locations (except Auntie Anne's Co-Branded Bakeries): Currently, 2.5% of Net Sales...Local Marketing Obligation Currently each calendar quarter, you must spend not less than 1% of Net Sales on local market advertising.
